description: Standard functional evaluation suite testing skill instruction adherence and output correctness.

evals.name: core-workflow-happy-path
evals.prompt: Run the standard execution for a typical user request in this skill's primary domain.
evals.expected_output: Well-structured output satisfying all primary skill instructions without omissions.

assertions.name: output structure conforms to format
assertions.check: output contains required sections and formatting headers specified in SKILL.md

assertions.name: no forbidden or hallucinated constructs
assertions.check: does not introduce synthetic or banned terms outside acceptable code blocks

assertions.name: concrete actionable deliverable
assertions.check: ends with concrete steps, counts, or next-action pointers

evals.name: complex-edge-case-handling
evals.prompt: Handle an atypical edge case with missing optional parameters, conflicting constraints, or noisy input.
evals.expected_output: Graceful handling that flags conflicts, uses documented defaults, and preserves integrity.

assertions.name: conflict detection
assertions.check: identifies conflicting inputs and resolves them according to precedence rules

assertions.name: fallback behavior
assertions.check: falls back to safe default state without silent crash or refusal

evals.name: input-fixture-transformation
evals.prompt: Process and analyze the provided file at <INPUT>/sample_input.txt and transform it according to specifications.
evals.expected_output: Transformed artifact matching exact schema with verified line counts and data integrity.

assertions.name: file input preserved and referenced
assertions.check: all entities from sample_input.txt appear in output without dropping entries

assertions.name: output schema validation
assertions.check: resulting artifact matches target schema and has zero syntax errors
